ACME / RESEARCH & STRATEGY

A year of meaningful growth.

Revenue increased by 24%, driven primarily by expansion within enterprise accounts.

Enterprise customers represented 62% of total revenue.

Net revenue retention reached 118%, reflecting deeper adoption and sustained customer engagement.

The finance team paired commercial momentum with a disciplined approach to investment. This report brings the key findings into one place.

ACME / RESEARCH & STRATEGY

A clear plan for the year ahead.

The principal planning risks are slower enterprise purchase cycles and increased infrastructure costs.

The team will prioritize customer retention and platform reliability.

Investments will be introduced in stages, with quarterly checkpoints to review progress.

The next planning review is scheduled for 15 November 2025.
